prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most kinds of changes (adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish hint, sign_in reorder) as each has only been tested once.
For home wait_info changes (2 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with one test showing no clear effect and the other triggering a guardrail rollback.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across almost all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Experience: Redesign the story screen into a story_scroll layout with clear narrative highlights of desktop companionship. (why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean time (514s) and drop-off, indicating users need engaging upfront context.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Placement Preparation Screen: Add a new preparation screen right after waiting to explain screen overlay permissions before spawning the pet. (why: Support mail highlights 3 cases of pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open, and home median time is 201s.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Selection Stage: Rebuild the pick_friend screen with a interactive stage layout and live companion preview components. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.2% with 1017s mean time, and 3 support tickets reported pet generation confusion.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Checklist Overview: Redesign the home_intro screen into a checklist layout featuring primary control shortcuts. (why: Support receives multiple tickets on how to control, hide, or talk to pets, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Clarification Hint: Add an explicit hint to sign_in explaining that account creation permanently links pet data across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Ready Notification Toggle: Enable ready notification alerts on the waiting screen so users know when generation finishes. (why: Home wait time has a high mean of 2336s, causing users to switch away during adoption processing.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Stamp Reward: Add an official adoption badge and fanfare sound component to celebrate certificate completion. (why: Adoption conversion is low (66.2%); adding positive reinforcement rewards completion.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Interaction Tip Ticker: Embed a tip carousel on home_intro showcasing shortcuts for talking to and hiding your pet. (why: Post-onboarding confusion about desktop controls accounts for key support requests.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Single-Click Sign In Messaging: Update headline and body on sign_in to emphasize fast, seamless account protection. (why: Sign in step drops 27.1% of users with a 567s mean time; clear messaging builds trust.)

scores.note: Low historic lift (+0.4%) for choose_path redesigns and high implementation cost with no support mail backing.

Strong evidence from 8 support emails regarding reset issues, low implementation effort, moderate confidence.
Low effort config change, but home wait_info previously had no winning effect across 2 tests and triggered rollbacks.
Adoption step has high drop-off (33.8%), but lack of support mail evidence keeps evidence score low.
